description:
[Trading Data API] Binance long/short ratios: global account, top-trader account, top-trader position, and taker buy/sell — Binance long/short ratios: global account, top-trader account, top-trader position, and taker buy/sell. Companion to funding-oi.

symbol.description: Required. Base crypto symbol (e.g. BTC). Mapped to <SYMBOL>USDT.
